pages.text: Plasma Filler: combines 1 Fusion Rod and 1,000 mb of matching plasma into 1 plasma fuel rod, taking 100 ticks.$(br2)This is the final step of fusion fuel production; the finished rod is placed directly into the $(l:akaishi:fusion)Fusion Reactor$(/l).

$(bold)Rod matching:$(reset) each Fusion Rod requires the matching plasma: mixed components produce Mixed rods, Nether components produce Nether rods and End components produce End rods.$(br2)Rod stats are in $(l:akaishi:plasma_rods)Plasma Fuel Rods$(/l); the Fusion Reactor layout is in $(l:akaishi:fusion)Fusion Reactor$(/l).
Plasma arrives from the $(l:akaishi:plasma_aggregator)Fusion Fuel Aggregator$(/l); the chain overview is in $(l:akaishi:plasma)Plasma Chain$(/l).
